quests.instruction: What is the action word for becoming extremely skilled at something through lots of practice?
quests.question: Master
quests.hint: Think about practicing the piano so many times that you can finally play a whole song perfectly.
quests.explanation: Master means to become extremely skilled at something. We master a new skill with lots of practice!
quests.funFact: Even the greatest experts had to practice for years to master their special skill!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for doing something extremely well, better than most people?
quests.question: Excel
quests.hint: Think about doing so well in a spelling test that you get every single word right.
quests.explanation: Excel means to do something extremely well. We excel at spelling after lots of careful practice!
quests.funFact: People often excel at the things they truly enjoy practicing the most!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for successfully reaching a goal after working hard?
quests.question: Achieve
quests.hint: Think about finally reaching your goal of reading ten whole books this year.
quests.explanation: Achieve means to successfully reach a goal. We achieve our reading goal after lots of hard work!
quests.funFact: Achieving a big goal often feels even better after all the hard work it took!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for successfully finishing something you set out to do?
quests.question: Accomplish
quests.hint: Think about finally finishing a huge, tricky puzzle you have worked on all week.
quests.explanation: Accomplish means to successfully finish something. We accomplish a huge puzzle after a whole week of work!
quests.funFact: Breaking a big task into smaller steps can help you accomplish it more easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for successfully getting past something difficult?
quests.question: Overcome
quests.hint: Think about finally getting past your fear to jump off the diving board.
quests.explanation: Overcome means to successfully get past something difficult. We overcome our fear to jump off the diving board!
quests.funFact: Overcoming a fear, one small brave step at a time, can feel truly amazing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for continuing to try hard even when something is difficult?
quests.question: Persevere
quests.hint: Think about practicing a hard math problem again and again until you finally solve it.
quests.explanation: Persevere means to keep trying hard even when something is difficult. We persevere until we solve a hard math problem!
quests.funFact: Persevering through a challenge is how so many amazing things get accomplished!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for continuing through something hard for a long time?
quests.question: Endure
quests.hint: Think about finishing a very long, tiring hike, even when your legs feel tired.
quests.explanation: Endure means to continue through something hard for a long time. We endure a long, tiring hike!
quests.funFact: Athletes train for months to build the strength needed to endure a long race!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for working hard to try to achieve something?
quests.question: Strive
quests.hint: Think about always trying your very best to improve your handwriting.
quests.explanation: Strive means to work hard to try to achieve something. We strive to improve our handwriting every day!
quests.funFact: Striving to improve a little each day can lead to amazing progress over time!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for hoping and working toward a big goal for your future?
quests.question: Aspire
quests.hint: Think about dreaming of becoming a scientist one day and studying hard to get there.
quests.explanation: Aspire means to hope and work toward a big future goal. Some children aspire to become scientists!
quests.funFact: Aspiring to a big dream can help guide all the small choices you make along the way!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for following after a goal with determination?
quests.question: Pursue
quests.hint: Think about working steadily, week after week, to pursue your dream of playing music well.
quests.explanation: Pursue means to follow after a goal with determination. We pursue our dream of playing music well!
quests.funFact: Pursuing a goal you truly care about can make even hard work feel rewarding!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for successfully reaching or getting something you worked for?
quests.question: Attain
quests.hint: Think about finally earning the highest badge in your scouting group after months of effort.
quests.explanation: Attain means to successfully reach or get something. We attain a special badge after months of effort!
quests.funFact: Attaining a goal you worked hard for can make you feel proud of your own progress!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for achieving a great success, especially after a real challenge?
quests.question: Triumph
quests.hint: Think about your whole team celebrating a huge win after a very difficult match.
quests.explanation: Triumph means to achieve a great success after a challenge. Our team can triumph after a difficult match!
quests.funFact: A hard-won triumph often feels even more special than an easy one!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for creating something on the spot, without planning ahead?
quests.question: Improvise
quests.hint: Think about a musician making up a brand new tune right on the spot during a show.
quests.explanation: Improvise means to create something on the spot, without planning. A musician can improvise a brand new tune!
quests.funFact: Improvising takes creativity and confidence to think quickly on your feet!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for planning out all the steps of a dance?
quests.question: Choreograph
quests.hint: Think about carefully planning every single step and movement for a class dance performance.
quests.explanation: Choreograph means to plan out the steps of a dance. A dance teacher can choreograph a fun performance!
quests.funFact: Choreographing a dance takes careful planning so every movement matches the music!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully organizing a big event so every part works together?
quests.question: Orchestrate
quests.hint: Think about carefully planning every part of a huge school festival so it all runs smoothly.
quests.explanation: Orchestrate means to carefully organize an event so every part works together. Teachers orchestrate a big school festival!
quests.funFact: Orchestrating a big event takes careful planning of every single detail in advance!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a bird building a home for its eggs and babies?
quests.question: Nest
quests.hint: Think about a bird carefully weaving twigs together to build a cozy home high in a tree.
quests.explanation: Nest means a bird builds a home for its eggs and babies. Birds nest high in the branches of trees!
quests.funFact: Some birds build their nest using twigs, while others use mud, feathers, or even spider silk!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for digging a tunnel or hole to live in underground?
quests.question: Burrow
quests.hint: Think about a rabbit digging a cozy tunnel underground to live in.
quests.explanation: Burrow means to dig a tunnel or hole to live in. Rabbits burrow cozy tunnels underground!
quests.funFact: Some animal burrows have many rooms and tunnels, almost like an underground home!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for an animal eating grass steadily in a field?
quests.question: Graze
quests.hint: Think about cows eating grass slowly and steadily across a big green field.
quests.explanation: Graze means an animal eats grass steadily in a field. Cows graze peacefully in green fields!
quests.funFact: Grazing animals often spend many hours a day slowly eating grass!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for searching around outside for food to eat?
quests.question: Forage
quests.hint: Think about a squirrel searching busily under leaves to find hidden nuts and seeds.
quests.explanation: Forage means to search around for food. A squirrel can forage under leaves for hidden nuts!
quests.funFact: Many wild animals forage every single day to find enough food to eat!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a bird settling down to rest or sleep, often up high?
quests.question: Roost
quests.hint: Think about chickens settling onto a wooden bar up high to sleep for the night.
quests.explanation: Roost means a bird settles down to rest, often up high. Chickens roost on a bar at night!
quests.funFact: Birds often roost together up high, safely away from animals on the ground!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a bird cleaning and smoothing its own feathers?
quests.question: Preen
quests.hint: Think about a swan carefully using its beak to smooth and clean its own feathers.
quests.explanation: Preen means a bird cleans and smooths its own feathers. A swan will preen its feathers with its beak!
quests.funFact: Preening helps keep a bird's feathers clean, smooth, and ready for flying!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for an animal losing its old fur, feathers, or skin?
quests.question: Shed
quests.hint: Think about a dog losing some of its old fur, which slowly grows back new again.
quests.explanation: Shed means an animal loses its old fur, feathers, or skin. A dog can shed its old fur throughout the year!
quests.funFact: Snakes shed their entire skin in one piece as they grow bigger!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for winding into a circular, curled-up shape?
quests.question: Coil
quests.hint: Think about a snake curling itself into a round, coiled shape to rest.
quests.explanation: Coil means to wind into a circular, curled-up shape. A snake can coil itself up to rest!
quests.funFact: A coiled rope or hose takes up much less space than one left in a straight line!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for squeezing tightly around something?
quests.question: Constrict
quests.hint: Think about a snake wrapping around a branch and squeezing tightly to hold on.
quests.explanation: Constrict means to squeeze tightly around something. A snake can constrict tightly around a branch!
quests.funFact: Some snakes are known as constrictors because of how tightly they can squeeze!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for searching carefully to find out true facts about something?
quests.question: Investigate
quests.hint: Think about looking closely for clues to solve a fun mystery game.
quests.explanation: Investigate means to search carefully to find true facts. We investigate clues to solve a mystery game!
quests.funFact: Investigating carefully means looking at every clue before making a decision!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for figuring out an answer using clues and clear thinking?
quests.question: Deduce
quests.hint: Think about looking at muddy footprints and figuring out which animal must have made them.
quests.explanation: Deduce means to figure out an answer using clues and clear thinking. We deduce which animal made muddy footprints!
quests.funFact: Great detectives in stories are famous for how cleverly they deduce the truth from small clues!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking closely at all the parts of something to understand it?
quests.question: Analyze
quests.hint: Think about looking closely at every clue in a story to understand what really happened.
quests.explanation: Analyze means to look closely at all the parts of something. We analyze the clues in a story carefully!
quests.funFact: Analyzing something carefully often helps you notice things you missed at first!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for explaining what something means?
quests.question: Interpret
quests.hint: Think about explaining what a tricky poem or a colorful painting is really trying to say.
quests.explanation: Interpret means to explain what something means. We interpret the meaning of a colorful painting!
quests.funFact: Two people can sometimes interpret the very same story in different, interesting ways!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully judging how good or how well something is?
quests.question: Evaluate
quests.hint: Think about carefully judging your own story to decide what parts could be even better.
quests.explanation: Evaluate means to carefully judge how good something is. We evaluate our own story to see what we can improve!
quests.funFact: Evaluating your own work honestly is a great way to keep getting better!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully judging the amount or quality of something?
quests.question: Assess
quests.hint: Think about carefully checking how much damage was done after a small storm.
quests.explanation: Assess means to carefully judge the amount or quality of something. We assess the damage after a small storm!
quests.funFact: Assessing a situation carefully helps you decide the very best next step to take!
